name: Trigger: Set Up QuickFind Popover
purpose: When the Quick Find popover opens, clears the QuickFind global (with triggers paused and committed) and puts the cursor in the field.

name: Perform QuickFind
purpose: Runs a Quick Find with the text in the QuickFind global on the current layout; shows all records and a "No Records Found" dialog on error, otherwise closes the popover.
open_question: Quick Find searches only the fields flagged for it on each layout; that setting is a layout property and is not shown here, so the searched fields per list layout are unresolved.

name: Close Find Popover and Show All
purpose: Closes the Find popover and shows all records of the current table.

name: Menu: Open Find Popover
purpose: Custom menu command (Cmd-F) that moves focus to the FindPopover layout object.
